latHint: What you'd get after buying a house, alongside the deed.
pivHint: The Psalmist writes of God's wonderful DEEDS. In real estate, the document proving you own a house is called its ______, alongside its deed.
winText: You found it. DEEDS isn't just God's wonderful acts — in real estate, a property's DEED goes hand in hand with its TITLE, both proving ownership.
lossText: The word was TITLE. DEEDS was the pivot — in real estate, a property's DEED and its TITLE are both documents proving who owns it.
votdVerse: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.
passageText: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds. I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing the praises of your name, O Most High.
